question: Please provide a list of the top three revenue-generating films for each actor, along with the average revenue per actor in those films, calculated by dividing the total film revenue equally among the actors for each film.
sql:
-- Final query: Top 3 revenue-generating films per actor with average revenue per actor in those films
WITH film_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        f.film_id,
        f.title,
        SUM(p.amount) as total_revenue
    FROM payment p
    JOIN rental r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id
    JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
    JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id
    GROUP BY f.film_id, f.title
),
film_actor_count AS (
    SELECT 
        film_id,
        COUNT(actor_id) as num_actors
    FROM film_actor
    GROUP BY film_id
),
film_revenue_per_actor AS (
    SELECT 
        fr.film_id,
        fr.title,
        fa.actor_id,
        fr.total_revenue / 1.0 / fac.num_actors as revenue_per_actor
    FROM film_revenue fr
    JOIN film_actor_count fac ON fr.film_id = fac.film_id
    JOIN film_actor fa ON fr.film_id = fa.film_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        actor_id,
        film_id,
        title,
        revenue_per_actor,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY actor_id ORDER BY revenue_per_actor DESC) as rn
    FROM film_revenue_per_actor
)
SELECT 
    a.actor_id,
    a.first_name,
    a.last_name,
    r.film_id,
    r.title,
    ROUND(r.revenue_per_actor, 2) as revenue_per_actor,
    ROUND(AVG(r.revenue_per_actor) OVER (PARTITION BY a.actor_id), 2) as avg_revenue_per_actor
FROM ranked r
JOIN actor a ON r.actor_id = a.actor_id
WHERE r.rn <= 3
ORDER BY a.actor_id, r.rn
